# Documentation templates

Copy a template into the appropriate `docs/`, `docs/adr/`, issue, PR, or evidence location and replace all placeholders. Delete sections that are genuinely not applicable; do not mark an external gate complete without evidence.

## Decision/design
- `ADR.md`, `RFC.md`, `DECISION-LOG.md`

## Change/delivery
- `CHANGE-REQUEST.md`, `DEPLOYMENT-PLAN.md`, `ROLLBACK-PLAN.md`, `RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`, `DATABASE-MIGRATION.md`, `API-CHANGE.md`

## Test/evidence
- `TEST-PLAN.md`, `TEST-CASE.md`, `UAT-EVIDENCE.md`, `BROKER-CERTIFICATION.md`, `DR-DRILL-REPORT.md`, `PERFORMANCE-REPORT.md`, `PRODUCTION-READINESS-EVIDENCE.md`

## Safety/operations
- `SECURITY-REVIEW.md`, `THREAT-MODEL.md`, `RISK-CHANGE.md`, `STRATEGY-VALIDATION.md`, `INCIDENT-REPORT.md`, `POSTMORTEM.md`, `RUNBOOK.md`

All templates inherit the safety rules in `../../AGENTS.md` and `../../SECURITY.md`.
